@pat.kids.common.hello core.pattern
    match="[hello|hi|hey] [there]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=chat.greet"
    kind=chat
    priority=10
    example="Hello!"

@pat.kids.common.name core.pattern
    match="[what_is|what_are|what_was] [your_name|you_called] [again|now]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=chat.name"
    kind=chat
    priority=12
    example="What is your name?"
    example="What are you called?"

@pat.kids.common.name.call core.pattern
    canonical="What should I call you?"
    match="[what_do_i_call_you|what_should_i_call_you|what_can_i_call_you|tell_me_your_name|may_i_ask_your_name|can_i_ask_your_name|can_you_tell_me_your_name]"

@pat.kids.common.meet core.pattern
    canonical="My name is Mia Lee."
    match="[hello|hi|hey]? [there]? my name is {n:words(3)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=chat.meet arg.name=\"{n|cap}\""
    kind=chat
    priority=12
    example="Hi, my name is Ben."
    example="My name is Mia Lee."
